stackDivergence.rationale: Task67 generalizes the existing original SoA count/fill/range constructor bindings to actual owned values. Original get(pos,T&) assigns an existing output reference; owned T get(pos) declares a default value, calls reference get_impl and returns that value, destroying the fresh local before propagating a failed lookup. Scalar result callers remain unchanged. Existing blocks_type insert/swap/equality/erase member bodies now occupy original main_def.inl boundary through thin header wrappers, with original algorithms and no runtime import cycle. Actual SharedString and CellTextAttr value members, macros, default traits, block dispatch and empty event owners are reused. Original CellTextAttrTraits and CellTextAttrStoreType bind the same shared constructor/prototype, not a second container engine. Whole unchanged mdds SoA headers with actual full SharedString/CellTextAttr sources produce normal-only complete owned1203 and Calc505-byte streams; original Calc trait declaration is a selected exact declaration witness from full pinned mtvelements.hxx, not a compilation or certification of its absent full pointee dependency graph. Erased ADL/type/output/ValueT constructor/destructor witnesses replace C++ syntax without runtime value-type inference. Reference/value reads, count/fill/range, copy/clone/move and failed result cleanup are bounded initialized witnesses. Other value/allocator/constructor/throwing-operator families, undefined ranges/lifetimes, physical ABI and complete upstream QA remain unverified. Full CellStoreType requires actual formula/edittext and associated owners; ScColumn/Table/Document/edit/undo/input/view/UI remain next prerequisites, with no whole module/kernel/UI parity promotion. Last full61; next full71.
